description: Source code for handling RAR archive operations including version checking, listing, extraction, addition, deletion, and password handling.

methods.name: xa_rar_check_version
methods.description: Checks the version of the RAR utility by executing a command line and parsing output.

methods.name: is_rar_hp
methods.description: Checks if a RAR archive has header encryption by reading specific bytes from the file.

methods.name: xa_rar_ask
methods.description: Configures archive capabilities based on whether it is a read-only or writable archive.

methods.name: xa_rar_password_str
methods.description: Generates a password string for RAR commands, escaping bad characters.

methods.name: xa_rar_v4_parse_output
methods.description: Parses output lines from RAR v4 archive listing to populate archive entries.

methods.name: xa_rar_parse_output
methods.description: Parses output lines from RAR v5 archive listing to populate archive entries.

methods.name: xa_rar_list
methods.description: Lists contents of a RAR archive, handling password detection and setting up display columns.

methods.name: xa_rar_test
methods.description: Tests the integrity of a RAR archive.

methods.name: xa_rar_extract
methods.description: Extracts files from a RAR archive based on a file list.

methods.name: xa_rar_add
methods.description: Adds files to a RAR archive with specified options.

methods.name: xa_rar_delete
methods.description: Deletes files from a RAR archive.
